ideas.name: NVIDIA Corporation
ideas.thesis: NVDA appeared in all 22 overnight screening runs with 21 high-conviction votes — the strongest consensus signal of the session. The company reported a blowout Q2 FY2027 on Aug 26, beating revenue estimates by ~4.5% ($96.2B vs. $92B consensus) and guiding FY2028 revenue growth of ~70% against a ~37% analyst expectation — nearly a 2x upside surprise. Despite the +8.74% post-earnings surge, the stock still trades at a meaningful discount to the consensus analyst target of $305 and well below the Raymond James street-high of $515, with supply commitments more than doubled to $279B and China data-center revenue representing pure upside optionality not included in guidance.
ideas.catalyst: Q2 FY2027 earnings reported Aug 26 after close (stock +8.74% Aug 27); next catalyst is Vera Rubin platform full production ramp at hyperscalers in late 2026 and Sep 16 FOMC
ideas.edge: Q3 guidance of ~$107–108B vs. $104B consensus (~3–4% beat); FY2028 growth guide of ~70% vs. ~37% analyst expectation; consensus PT of $305 implies ~44% upside from current levels; 58 of 61 analysts rate Buy/Strong Buy; Raymond James street-high target of $515
ideas.bull_case: Vera Rubin GPU ramp in late 2026 represents a second growth wave not yet priced in; China data-center revenue exclusion from guidance is pure upside optionality if restrictions ease, and doubled supply commitments of $279B give multi-year revenue visibility.
ideas.bear_case: Post-earnings IV remains elevated, making outright options expensive; a hawkish Warsh speech today could trigger broad tech de-rating; and at ~$228 the stock has already priced in much of the near-term beat, leaving macro as the dominant short-term driver.

ideas.name: SK Hynix Inc. Sponsored ADR
ideas.thesis: SKHY appeared in all 22 overnight runs with unanimous high conviction — the only idea to achieve that distinction. As NVIDIA's primary HBM memory supplier under a $500B+ AI infrastructure partnership, SKHY is the most direct earnings read-through play on NVDA's blowout results: NVDA's $89B data center quarter and ~70% FY2028 growth guide structurally validate multi-year HBM demand, yet SKHY has pulled back ~11–12% from its Aug 17 high of $178 to ~$158, creating a re-entry opportunity. Multiple independent catalysts compound the thesis: Needham raised its price target to $220 on Aug 24, Temasek sovereign wealth fund backing is confirmed, a 40 trillion won share buyback was announced, and the Dalian NAND plant restart adds incremental capacity upside.
ideas.catalyst: NVDA Q2 FY2027 blowout earnings (Aug 26) directly validates HBM demand runway; Needham PT raised to $220 on Aug 24; Temasek sovereign wealth investment confirmed; 40 trillion won buyback announced; NVDA +8.74% Aug 27 acting as pre-market catalyst today
ideas.edge: Stock at ~$158 vs. Needham PT of $220 = ~39% upside gap; revenue +40.8% YoY, net income +108% YoY, EPS +103.85% YoY; ROIC ~73.5%; ~11% pullback from Aug 17 high of $178 despite intact and now re-confirmed AI demand story
ideas.bull_case: NVDA's doubled supply commitments to $279B and ~70% FY2028 growth guide lock in multi-year HBM procurement from SKHY; the Temasek backing and ₩100T shareholder return plan (BofA forecast) provide a valuation floor while the buyback reduces share count.
ideas.bear_case: ADR liquidity and FX (KRW/USD) can amplify volatility; DRAM pricing cycles can reverse quickly if hyperscaler capex moderates; a hawkish Warsh speech today could reprice risk assets broadly and mask SKHY's fundamental re-rating.

ideas.name: Invesco QQQ Trust (Nasdaq-100 ETF)
ideas.thesis: QQQ appeared in 18 of 22 overnight runs, all at medium conviction, reflecting its role as the cleanest vehicle for today's binary macro event rather than a directional stock bet. Fed Chair Warsh delivers his inaugural Jackson Hole keynote at 10:00 AM ET — just 19 days before the Sep 16 FOMC decision with ~33% hike odds priced. NVDA's blowout print already lifted Nasdaq futures ~1% pre-open, providing a bullish tailwind into the event, while NVDA's ~9% QQQ weight means the index has built-in upside leverage if sentiment holds. The options structure (short-dated straddle or call spread) is the consensus-preferred expression across all 18 runs.
ideas.catalyst: Fed Chair Warsh inaugural Jackson Hole keynote TODAY Aug 28 at 10:00 AM ET; Sep 16 FOMC decision 19 days out with ~33% rate hike odds priced
ideas.edge: September rate hike odds dropped from ~60% to ~33% on soft macro data — asymmetric upside if Warsh signals pause; NVDA's ~9% QQQ weight contributes ~0.8% index upside from earnings alone; Nasdaq-100 at 26,541 with room to retest YTD highs on dovish signal; VIX declining into event = relatively cheap straddle premium for a high-uncertainty binary
ideas.bull_case: A dovish or neutral Warsh tone confirming a September pause would trigger a consensus repricing of tech/growth multiples; combined with NVDA's blowout earnings tailwind, QQQ could push 1.5–2%+ intraday toward YTD highs.
ideas.bear_case: A hawkish surprise — or even Warsh withholding forward guidance (as he has done before) — could spike yields and reprice the Nasdaq sharply lower; with the 30-yr yield already at 5.31%, any rate-hike signal is a meaningful headwind to QQQ's growth-heavy composition.

ideas.name: Microsoft Corporation
ideas.thesis: MSFT appeared in 15 of 22 overnight runs as the consensus pick for a lower-beta, liquid way to ride NVDA's AI capex confirmation. As the largest hyperscaler customer of NVDA and a co-architect of the $600B+ 2026 AI capex cycle, MSFT's Azure AI infrastructure expansion is directly validated by NVDA's blowout results and ~70% FY2028 growth guide. Despite this, MSFT's own stock moved only +0.9–1.8% on NVDA's print — a notable lag that screens flagged as a potential catch-up gap heading into MSFT's own late-October 2026 earnings. The name offers superior options liquidity relative to SKHY for defined-risk swing plays.
ideas.catalyst: NVDA's blowout Q2 FY2027 earnings (Aug 26) confirm hyperscaler AI capex acceleration; next MSFT-specific catalyst is late October 2026 earnings; today's Warsh speech is a rate-sensitivity event for MSFT's growth multiple
ideas.edge: MSFT at ~$505 (Aug 27 close) with Wall Street consensus projecting 15–18% FY2027 revenue growth; muted +0.9% reaction to NVDA's blowout vs. the underlying AI capex read-through implies a catch-up gap; collective hyperscaler AI capex commitments of $600B+ in 2026 reduce demand uncertainty flagged as key bear risk into Oct earnings
ideas.bull_case: NVDA's guidance removes the principal uncertainty overhang on MSFT's Azure AI investment cycle; a dovish Warsh speech today would additionally re-rate MSFT's growth multiple, with options providing clean pre-earnings risk-defined exposure.
ideas.bear_case: Higher-for-longer rates are the primary valuation headwind — a hawkish Warsh surprise today could pressure MSFT more than the broader market given its elevated P/E; the AI capex validation is already partially reflected in the stock's strong YTD performance.

ideas.name: SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust
ideas.thesis: SPY appeared in 2 of 22 runs — just at the minimum threshold — exclusively as an options/hedge vehicle around today's Warsh Jackson Hole keynote. The idea is not a directional bet but a structured straddle or strangle to capture the binary policy signal from Warsh's first-ever speech as Fed Chair, where he has previously withheld his own dot-plot projection and shortened FOMC statements by 50%, creating calibration uncertainty. With VIX subdued going into the event and 3 hawkish FOMC dissents in July signaling internal fault lines, the options premium is relatively cheap for a potentially high-magnitude event.
ideas.catalyst: Fed Chair Warsh Jackson Hole keynote TODAY Aug 28 ~10:00 AM ET; September 15–16 FOMC meeting with ~33–34% rate hike odds priced
ideas.edge: VIX declining into event = cheap straddle/strangle premium relative to binary outcome uncertainty; 30-yr yield at 5.31% (highest since 2007) creates asymmetric upside if Warsh signals hold-through-2026; dovish signal = 2–3% SPY rally; hawkish surprise = 1–2% pullback — either move is capturable intraday
ideas.bull_case: A hold signal from Warsh compresses the risk premium embedded in equities since the July hawkish dissents; combined with NVDA's earnings lift, SPY could rally 2–3% intraday from ~7,720, making the call side of the straddle the winner.
ideas.bear_case: With only 2 of 22 runs flagging this idea, the consensus is thin — the straddle is a hedge expression, not a primary trade; if Warsh is deliberately ambiguous (his known style), the market may not move enough to overcome the premium paid on the straddle.

ideas.edge: Stock at ~$313 vs. median analyst target of $335 = ~7% gap; 28 of 46 analysts at Buy/Strong Buy; record June quarter with gross margin benefiting from tariff refunds; CEO transition historically creates implied vol spikes, making options premium a two-way opportunity
ideas.bull_case: iPhone 17 launch on Sep 9 is a dated hardware catalyst with a clean fundamental setup — record installed base, double-digit growth across all geographies, and a new M6 chip cycle could drive a September re-rating event similar to prior launch cycles.
ideas.bear_case: CEO transitions inject genuine leadership uncertainty that the market has not fully priced; with only 2 of 22 screens flagging AAPL, the AI/data-center thematic momentum is elsewhere today, and AAPL's limited direct NVDA read-through makes it a lower-priority idea in this environment.
